prompt: I have two rules files: .claude/rules/ui-rules.md (8 T3 blocks, 2 critical, 3 scopeless) and .claude/rules/code-rules.md (4 T3 blocks, 0 critical, 0 scopeless). I need enforcement blocks on the 3 new rules at the bottom of code-rules.md. Make sure you count budgets across BOTH files.
assertions: The skill reads BOTH rules files before classifying
Pre-classification budget report shows aggregated totals: 12 T3, 2 critical, 3 scopeless across both files
'Test files must not import from other test files' is classified as T1 (regex on import paths)
'Components must not exceed 200 lines' is classified as T1 (line count is syntactic)
Post-classification budget report includes T3 counts from ui-rules.md even though only code-rules.md was edited
The per-file breakdown is shown alongside the aggregated totals
